description: Same club, packed and delighted. A dancer in a red sequined top and long slit pink skirt, long black hair, moves through the crowd; a soldier leans close in mock courtship while the room laughs. FRONT LEFT: a soldier crouches with a 35mm CAMERA fitted with a FLASH UNIT — a second photographer documenting the night (relevant to who shot which frames). Tables with checkered cloths hold beverage cans. At least a dozen audience faces are sharp: crew cuts, fatigues with tapes and chevrons (one PFC chevron visible), a few civilian shirts. The clarinetist plays at right; pink-shaded wall lamps and blue posts frame the room; woven mat ceiling above.
